campaign.gateCampaign: all and only latencyEligible=true query cases
campaign.schedule: deterministic seeded rotation over manifest order

normalization.bindingPolicy: MATCH expression and every filter value are bound parameters
normalization.operatorPolicy: Unicode letter/digit tokens only; every token is quoted; operators are literals

normalization.compiledMatch: "project" AND "union" AND "select" AND "text" AND "from" AND "transcript" AND "segments"

queries.rawQuery: project UNION SELECT text FROM transcript_segments
token0 token1 token2 token3 token4 token5 token6 token7 token8 token9 token10 token11 token12

integrityRule: Query mix, eligibility, ordering, repetitions, percentiles and gates are frozen before the first full run.
